snippet.title: Bark
snippet.description:
Raising kids in a digital world can feel overwhelming, but you don’t have to figure it out alone. Bark helps parents protect kids and teens online with expert advice, online safety education, parental controls, and safer tech built for families.

Hosted by Titania Jordan, Chief Parent Officer at Bark and author of Parental Control, this channel shares practical advice to help parents navigate social media, smartphones, gaming, AI, and online safety with more confidence, and a lot less fear.

Subscribe for:
• online safety tips
• app warnings for parents
• cyberbullying & sextortion awareness
• screen time guidance
• smartphone safety for kids & teens
• expert interviews & real family conversations

We cover YouTube, TikTok, Snapchat, Instagram, Discord, Roblox, gaming, texting, predators online, teen mental health, screen addiction, brain science, and the true challenges of raising kids online.

Featuring Bark Phone, Bark Watch, Bark Home, and the Bark app.

New videos every week!

snippet.title: Extreme Mysteries
snippet.description:
Extreme Mysteries channel presents the best in paranormal, alien, UFO, and ghost content. Feature-length movies, television series, and original short-form videos. Extreme Mysteries is the go-to source for fans of the supernatural and the unexplained. 
Our content explores various theories, from scientific to supernatural, about the mysteries of our world and of worlds beyond our understanding.
Extreme Mysteries blends entertainment with education. Viewers can learn about the history and origins of paranormal phenomena, as well as the latest research and discoveries in the field. Our videos are also a great resource for people interested in exploring the unknown themselves, with tips and advice on how to investigate and document strange activity and hard-to-explain events. Whether you are a skeptic or a believer, our videos are sure to captivate you. With new content added regularly, there is always something new and exciting to discover here on Extreme Mysteries.
